verdict.rationale: Running an operating system headlessly or in CI is a fair question for Ubuntu Desktop, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents headless operation, CI runner images, or automation without a display. The only related items are adjacent: a command-line tutorial, the WSL terminal environment and Amazon WorkSpaces cloud desktops. None of these establishes a headless or CI mode for Ubuntu Desktop itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
